terra.problem: The joke makes the Father, the Spirit and Jesus the subjects of a table-and-drawer comparison. Humor must not target God or Jesus.
The claim about Jesus’ birth and baptism refers to events outside this passage without Scripture references.

Saying the prophets did their searching for someone else’s table adds a purpose for their searching. Peter says they searched to determine the time and setting and were revealed to be serving his readers when they foretold these things.
The passage does not say that angels stand close to heaven.
